title: HON Ignition 2.0 Mid‑Back Ergonomic Office Chair, Mesh Task Seating with Lumbar Support, Advanced Synchro‑Tilt, Height and Width Adjustable Arms, Titanium Frame, Bullseye
features: ERGONOMIC WORK SUPPORT: Designed as an ergonomic office chair for desk and computer use; mid‑back mesh provides airflow while lumbar support promotes proper posture during long hours at a home office desk

ADJUSTABLE COMFORT: Advanced synchro‑tilt recline supports normal movement; pneumatic seat height and adjustable arms help align shoulders, arms, and lower back for a comfortable desk chair experience
BREATHABLE MESH DESIGN: Mesh office chair back improves ventilation to keep you cool; contoured seat cushion offers balanced support for daily work, study, or gaming chair use without bulk

VERSATILE FOR HOME OR OFFICE: Rolling desk chair with wheels and swivel base fits under office desks and computer desks; ideal as a desk chair ergonomic solution for home office, study spaces, or shared work areas
BUILT FOR EVERYDAY USE: Supports up to 300 lb; durable construction backed by the HON Full Warranty for long‑term confidence in your office chair investment
